## What changes

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Link the related issue if present.

## Verification

List the commands or manual checks actually completed and their results.
For UI/browser changes, include relevant screenshots and the testing level.
Record unavailable platform, account or hardware checks explicitly.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] Relevant behaviour and documentation agree.
- [ ] No credentials, personal profiles/databases or generated build output are included.
- [ ] Any changed security boundary retains its validation and regression coverage.

Normally target `dev`. Installer publication follows RELEASING.md separately.
